title: A Truly Awful App
body:
If I could give this zero stars, I would. Here we have an app designed to help organise your life and develop good habits - as opposed to bad ones. Its target user (I surmise) will be a chaotic, out of control last-minute-er who has, to this point (in order to survive the chaos) implemented all sorts of ill-advised, sketchy and short term life hacks so as to keep their heads above water. Many neurodiverse people will know exactly what that existence looks like! And the app would seem heaven sent for them - it will provide a routine and a structure and walls. Except it isn’t! And why? Because it gives NO clue as to how to actually use it. And to say it’s self explanatory is FAR from the truth. As far as I can tell, the app is ‘organised’ around a group of “I wish” challenges which are SO loosely linked - one to the other and to any idea of a cohesive governing ‘system’ - that it actually adds to the chaos of trying to bring order and routine to your life.

I mean it’s truly astonishing - like a bucket that’s offered up to hold water. But it has no bottom. So the one thing it can’t do - AND THE ONLY THING A BUCKET IS BUILT FOR - is keep a liquid inside it...

Dreadful.

Oh, yeah and there’s no customer support.

title: Not Routinery!
body:
Very confusing. I should have looked at the reviews, since there are only 3. But it was recommended on a video, so I didn’t. I even paid for a month because it has such intrusive ads! Now I would like a refund.
It was similar enough to the other app that it was only when I clicked through a direct link to the app that I realized my mistake!
author: obsidity

title: Routinery - great app for habit tracking
body: I really like the way you show all the activities in a week view page which gives me the 💡 ideas of what I need to do next to meet my goal. The challenges are interesting to pick and share my friends. One thing could be improved is to integrate some activities with Pomodoro feature so that I could measure the time I spend for them. Overall this App is great for habits making and tracking which I will recommend for my friends as well. Hope you continue this good work.
